item.title: 🏋️‍♂️ Russia's Weightlifting Federation Russia will host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships
item.description: 🏋️‍♂️ Russia's Weightlifting Federation : 🇷🇺 Russia will host the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships ! Hosting rights for the 2030 World Championships were awarded as part of a single strategic package within a major IWF bidding process . Russia will host
the 2030 World Weightlifting Championships

the 2032 Olympic Games

Russia's Weightlifting Federation
is the first federation representing an Olympic sport to secure
the return of an official top-level competition in an Olympic discipline to the Russian Federation since 2022
, following a lengthy hiatus.
Hosting rights for the 2030 World Championships were awarded as part of a single strategic package within

.
Russia’s bid offered the strongest long-term programme

🏆
The international community has praised the standard of events hosted in our country and the federation’s work.
The World Championships are returning to Russia thanks to cooperation between
the Russian Weightlifting Federation
, led by
Alexander Vinokurov
, and
the International Weightlifting Federation
(
#IWF
), with support from Russia's Minister of Sports
Mikhail Degtyarev
.
💬
President of the Russian Weightlifting Federation
Alexander Vinokurov:
We thank the International Weightlifting Federation for its trust.
Russia has all the experience and capabilities needed to host competitions of the highest standard. Moscow has repeatedly hosted major international sporting events and has modern infrastructure.
Our task is to deliver a world-class championship and provide the best possible conditions for athletes, coaches and everyone taking part. I am confident that the competition will be a true celebration of weightlifting and a crucial step on the athletes’ journey to the 2032 Olympics.
Much work lies ahead, but today we have achieved a truly historic result!
🇷🇺
We look forward to seeing you in Moscow!

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/MFARussia/32972

🗓
On October 22,
the Nizhny Novgorod Economic Forum
concluded in
Nizhny Novgorod
.
Thanks to the extensive
business programme
, representatives of government, Russian and foreign entrepreneurs, academia and development institutions had the opportunity to discuss
practical solutions for implementing international projects
.
The main event was
the Plenary Session “Advancing international cooperation at the confluence of the Oka and Volga”.
🌐
The event gathered
more than 600 government representatives, business leaders and diplomats from 27 countries
, including
China, India, Brazil, Azerbaijan and Sri Lanka
.
The Forum was organised by
the Government of the Nizhny Novgorod Region
and
the Oka Agency
.
💬
Governor of the Nizhny Novgorod Region
Gleb Nikitin
:
Before 2022, almost 80% of our region’s exports went west – to Europe and the US.
Over the past few years, however, the vast majority of enterprises in the Nizhny Novgorod Region have managed to redirect their sales to new markets – primarily India and China. Companies in our region and across Russia have learned to compete with leading global manufacturers under these extremely challenging conditions.
Throughout the discussion, speakers emphasised that, as the world moves towards
#Multipolarity
, Russia is developing new logistics routes and strengthening ties within the
#EAEU
,
#CIS
,
#SCO
and
#BRICS
, while
attempts to isolate our country are doomed to fail
.
💬
Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov:
It is deeply symbolic that this forum is taking place in Nizhny Novgorod, where fairs have been held for centuries, helping establish and develop trade and personal ties between Russia, Europe, Central Asia, India and Persia.
I hope the Nizhny Novgorod Economic Forum will likewise become a meeting point for all those interested in doing business with our country.
Chinese representatives proposed making greater use of
the Yangtze-Volga cooperation mechanism
to establish joint production facilities, conduct scientific research and enter third-country markets.
Cooperation with African countries
was also identified as a promising area
, with companies from the Nizhny Novgorod Region well placed to supply industrial equipment, medical devices, food products and IT solutions.
✍️
Three cooperation agreements
were also signed at the Forum:
• between
Privolzhsky Research Medical University
and
the University Clinical Centre of Republika Srpska
(Bosnia and Herzegovina);
• between
the Nizhny Novgorod Region Export Support Centre
and the Association for Business Cooperation between Exporters and Middle Eastern Countries;
• between the Agency for Attracting Foreign Talent and the
Oka Agency
.
The success of the inaugural Forum has set the course for its development –
this is only the beginning
!
Next year, the Forum is expected to become
a
two-day event
, with
a
stronger focus on interregional cooperation
, pooling the capabilities of Russia’s regions to attract foreign partners and implement joint projects.
👉
LEARN MORE
#NEF2026

item.title: ✉️ On October 26, President of Russia Vladimir Putin sent a congratulatory message to President of Brazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
item.description: ✉️ On October 26, President of Russia Vladimir Putin sent a congratulatory message to President of Brazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva . ✍️ Please accept my heartfelt congratulations on your re-election as President of the Federative Republic of Brazil . The election results fully reaffirmed your fellow citizens’ recognition of your outstanding leadership qualities and their support for your policies aimed at ensuring the country’s sustainable socioeconomic development and defending its sovereignty and legitimate interests on the world stage. Your personal contribution to strengthening the strategic partnership between Brazil and Russia cannot be overstated. 🤝 We will, of course, continue working closely together to expand our fruitful bilateral cooperation across all areas and our constructive engagement within the #UN , #BRICS , the #G20 and other multilateral frameworks. I would also like to extend my heartfelt congratulations on your birthday and wish you sound health, happiness, well-being and continued success in your work for the benefit of the friendly Brazilian people. Kind regards, VLADIMIR PUTIN 🇷🇺 🇧🇷 #RussiaBrasil

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : PHOTO FACTS & EVIDENCE of crimes committed by Ukrainian armed forces over the week of October 19-25, 2026 : ▪️ October 20 – a UAV strike on a civilian passenger car in Raigorodok, LPR. One civilian was killed and two others were injured. ▪️ October 20 – a UAV strike on a civilian cargo vehicle in the Stanichno-Lugansky District, LPR. ▪️ October 21 – a UAV strike on the Lugansk Telephone Company building in Lugansk, LPR. Two civilians were killed. ▪️ October 22 – a UAV strike on an EMERCOM water tanker in the Volnovakha District, DPR. One rescue worker was injured. ▪️ October 22 – a Strike on a pharmacy building in Kakhovka, Kherson Region. ▪️ October 24 – a UAV strike on a specialised construction vehicle belonging to the Zaporozhye Region Road Administration in the Primorsky Municipal District, Zaporozhye Region. ▪️ October 24 – a UAV strike on an apartment building in Sverdlovsk, LPR. Four civilians were injured. ▪️ October 24 – a UAV strike on an EMERCOM water tanker in the Telmanovsky District, DPR. ▪️ October 25 – Aftermath of a massive UAV attack on Belgorod, Belgorod Region. Three civilians were killed and 13 were injured. ▪️ October 25 – a UAV strike on a passenger bus travelling on the Moscow-Melitopol route in the Zaporozhye Region. Three civilians were injured.
